detail: Both F2P tests assert exact unmentioned log text "Import cache refresh failed", differing from the issue's suggested warning message.
All F2P tests check View.metadata_location from REST responses, directly specified in the issue and mirroring Table.
All F2P tests verify the described full-prompt cache denominator and defensive handling of optional legacy SQLite columns.
Seven of twelve F2P tests directly call unmentioned new helpers upd._update_blocker_snapshot() or run_drain.all_active_runs().
Three of four F2P tests assert exact regex "gl_NumWorkGroups: .*not in a <stage> entry point|helper function" for unmentioned non-compute refusals.
Issue leaves preserve vs reject open, while all four F2P tests hardcode unmentioned generated column names __gexf_source_1__, __gexf_target_1__, and meta["source_col"].
All F2P tests check DocumentLoadError matching existing _BOM_ENCODINGS names with UnicodeDecodeError cause, matching the issue.
Tests require unmentioned lowering choices: non-literal barrier(mask) emits allMemoryBarrier instead of refusing, global|image emits deviceMemoryBarrier, and 0 emits workgroupExecutionBarrier.
Issue offers either a new metric function or ope(signed=True); both F2P tests require choosing the second option.
Issue targets str Body fields only, but test_multipart_scalar_body_types requires extending plain-text form parsing to date, Enum, and Optional[str].
All four F2P tests assert exact newly invented ValueError substring "path value is empty", unmentioned in the issue and unpatterned in codebase.
All F2P tests check UNION [ALL] BY NAME and UNION ALL CORRESPONDING column lineage as explicitly specified.
Issue requests a multiprocess=True middleware flag, but both F2P tests import app and broker from an unmentioned new docs example module.
Both F2P tests verify private block cache invalidation on pop, popitem, clear, and overwrite as specified.
Tests splice out an unmentioned Phase 1b WAT section, reject two of three fix directions offered in the issue, and test unmentioned VERA_GC_CHECK_MARKS.
Three of seven F2P tests directly call a newly invented helper proto_utils.parse_lenient not mentioned in the issue.
Tests require guessing the reasoning_effort="none" workaround and an unmentioned model name "gpt-6-sol".
Both F2P tests verify the three Pow singularity bugs and continuous_domain behavior explicitly described in the issue.
Issue scopes fix strictly to longer closing fences, but two F2P tests also require indented fences and unclosed fences running to EOF.
F2P test directly reproduces numeric field alias validation from object/Schema inputs described in the issue.
Both F2P tests check thread-safe SuppressStdoutStderr refcounting and EBADF fallback without leaking FDs, directly specified in the issue.
Fourteen of seventeen F2P tests directly invoke unmentioned private symbols mcp._http_call_timing, _http_slow_call_warn_secs, _HTTP_SLOW_CALL_WARN_DEFAULT, or _HTTP_SLOW_CALL_WARN_ENV.
F2P test verifies Snowflake-to-DuckDB DATE_TRUNC/TRUNC/TRUNCATE casting for DATE inputs using existing input_type_preserved logic.
Issue vaguely suggests rotating labels or fewer ticks on EventList.peek(), while F2P test requires MapAxis.format_plot_xaxis to drop minor labels and use ScalarFormatter.
F2P test hardcodes unmentioned BriefcaseCommandError substrings and a different Docker WSL docs URL than the one in the issue.
F2P test runs the exact closed-interval add_triple replay reproducer described in the issue.
One of four F2P tests tests an unrelated unmentioned bug where SubPages._show clears _rendered_path before nested refreshable rebuilds.
Both F2P tests assert ValueError for non-positive export_timeout_millis in BatchSpanProcessor and BatchLogRecordProcessor as specified.
Instruction table explicitly renames Grid.reordered to transpose, directly contradicting five F2P tests that call Grid.select.
F2P test verifies @await_on_shutdown protects ui.timer callbacks during teardown while keeping client context, as described.
F2P test requires unmentioned conflict-only validation in _validate_mail_config (allowing matching full addresses) plus exact detail substring "credential.domain".
Invalid materialization test asserts newly invented error messages "Unexpected argument ..." and "The adapter of a materialization must be a literal.".
F2P test asserts the exact three nanosecond-to-string values given in the issue.
F2P test checks the exact upstream SBOM versionInfo and purl behavior described in the issue.
Both F2P tests require unmentioned multi-import isolation, no suffix matching, and rejecting site_name_to_idx aliasing (contradicting the issue's hint).
All F2P tests verify constant and one-term LinearExpression times multi-term expression on both backends, as specified.
test_exptrigsimp tests an unrelated unmentioned trig simplification issue (#22134 in trigsimp.py) bundled into the upstream PR.
test_debug_mode asserts exact capitalization "Internal Server Error." (contradicting issue example) and exact unmentioned doc anchor "content/how-to/debugging.html#debug-mode".
All F2P tests check De Bruijn trial argument labels via public CLI reports, matching the issue.
All F2P tests check pivot_longer does not alias input arrays across the exact paths described in the issue.
Four of nine F2P tests require the unmentioned policy choice to clear provider.cooldown = None after calling sources.get_source_provider().
F2P test verifies sorting indented import blocks followed by less-indented imports as reproduced in the issue.
F2P test runs the exact PEP 695 generic type alias reproducer from the issue.
All F2P tests verify concurrent robots.txt waiters share the parsed result safely and isolate cancellation, consistent with existing tests.
Issue claims seeded fast paths are right and full path is broken, but tests require changing the fast path and emitting unmentioned trace reason "duplicate_seed_id".
test_rle_id_nullable_values requires an unmentioned dtype change from Int64 to int64, including on the unmentioned non-groupby df.rle_id path.
Issue targets directories configured in skip (explicitly distinguishing .gitignore-only #1895), while the sole F2P test only checks a .gitignore-ignored folder not in skip.
The sole F2P test checks KeyError detail preservation alongside trailing credential redaction, directly matching the issue.
All three F2P tests depend on unmentioned default parameter changes in _get_default_norm (scan_min=0.1, scan_max=10, scan_n_values=21).
All F2P tests verify CV06 multiline_newline preserves SELECT, INSERT, and DELETE execution across detached line comments as described.
F2P test uses MOTO_SQS_ENFORCE_STRICT_QUEUE_PURGE_BEHAVIOUR, directly derived from the issue's function name and moto/settings.py convention.
All F2P tests verify unequal-dimension Kraus/Choi is_quantum_channel(dim=...) and channel_relative_entropy as specified in the issue.
All three F2P tests require an unmentioned design: always generating .ps1 for consumers/test_package without the conf, excluding cache packages, and gating usage on the conf.
All F2P tests verify standard PEP 695 generic TypeAliasType parameter substitution described in the issue.
Five of six F2P tests require unmentioned removal of _write_metadata (contradicting base test_metadata_written) or unmentioned interruptible heartbeat wait.
F2P test checks all three Set-Cookie Expires parsing defects explicitly specified in the issue.
